title: NATO Airspace Incursions Tracker Update — Sep 6, 2026
summary: A resident in Vaslui County, Romania found an explosive-laden drone in a field roughly 30 km from the Moldovan border on September 1; Romania's Intelligence Service (SRI) counter-terrorism unit safely detonated it hours later with no casualties. The discovery came as Romania joined France, Belgium, Portugal, the Netherlands and the EU in summoning Russian ambassadors on September 2 over Germany's formal attribution of the Leipzig/Halle Airport drone attack to Russia, with interim Foreign Minister Oana Ţoiu saying Romania 'will not tolerate Russia's hybrid actions' and citing 44 unauthorized drone incursions since the war began. title: NATO Airspace Incursions Tracker Update — Sep 4, 2026
summary: Polish fighter jets intercepted Russian Il-20 reconnaissance aircraft over the Baltic Sea near Łeba (Aug 31) and Ustka (Sep 3) without any airspace violation — the 9th and 10th such intercepts of 2026 — prompting Defence Minister Władysław Kosiniak-Kamysz to expand F-16 and helicopter patrols along Poland's coast. Separately, NATO scrambled Turkish F-16s overnight into September 1 after roughly ten drones approached Estonia's border with Russia; one briefly crossed into Estonian airspace near Narva before returning, while Latvia issued and lifted an airspace warning for Alūksne municipality with no confirmed incursion. In Bucharest on September 3, European Council President António Costa voiced solidarity with Romania over 'deeply concerning' airspace and maritime drone violations. title: NATO Airspace Incursions Tracker Update — Aug 29, 2026
summary: Slovakia's government approved deploying up to 101 troops and new 3D radar systems (range ~350 km) to Poland and Romania to reinforce NATO's Eastern Sentry mission, becoming the latest ally to contribute additional detection capability along the eastern flank. Defence Minister Robert Kaliňák said the deployment would help 'protect the airspace of our allies' while giving Slovak forces real-world experience with the new radars; Polish Defence Minister Władysław Kosiniak-Kamysz called it 'an important contribution' to eastern-flank security. No new airspace incursions, intercepts, or shootdowns were reported across Poland, Romania, the Baltic states, or Germany between August 26–29. title: NATO Airspace Incursions Tracker Update — Aug 28, 2026
summary: German investigators recovered a third drone and roughly 50 grams of suspected military-grade hexogen in a field at Kabelsketal, just west of Leipzig/Halle Airport, on August 14 — a find reported this week that widens the probe into the August 4 plot against Ukrainian Antonov cargo aircraft; Chancellor Friedrich Merz warned that those behind 'hybrid attacks' against Germany 'will pay for them.' Separately, Latvia's National Armed Forces confirmed on August 20 that the drone shot down near Rugāji on August 14 was Ukrainian-made, redirected into Latvian airspace by Russian electronic-warfare jamming rather than a Russian-launched weapon — resolving one specific case in the broader deliberate-vs-stray debate. No new airspace incursions, intercepts, or shootdowns were reported across Poland, Romania, the Baltic states, or Germany in the past three days. Timeline, map points, map lines, claims, political figures, and KPIs updated accordingly.

title: NATO Airspace Incursions Tracker Update — Aug 25, 2026
summary: A drone crossed from Moldova on the morning of August 24 and crashed into a walnut tree near a home in Ciușlea village, Garoafa commune, Vrancea County; the Defence Ministry found no explosives and evacuated a roughly 300-metre perimeter. Hours later, Spanish F/A-18s scrambled twice — at 22:37 near Snake Island and again at 07:31 the next morning near Vâlcove — after radar detected approaching targets, though neither incident was confirmed to have entered Romanian airspace. Romania's own incident dashboard now counts 25 confirmed drone incursions in 2026 (vs. 9 in 2025) and 47 fighter-scramble situations (vs. 21). title: NATO Airspace Incursions Tracker Update — Aug 23, 2026
summary: Backfilled two Romanian incidents from the morning of August 20: a drone crashed near Grindu in Tulcea County after crossing from the Ukrainian border, and roughly three hours later a Romanian F-16 destroyed an explosive-laden maritime drone with cannon fire near the Neptun Deep offshore gas project — the Air Force's first gun kill and first maritime-drone engagement of the wave. President Nicușor Dan blamed Russia for an 'intensification of irresponsible incidents,' and European Commission President von der Leyen called it part of an 'escalating campaign of threats.' NATO's confirmed drone-shootdown tally rises to eight. KPIs, map points, map lines, political figures, and claims updated accordingly.

title: NATO Airspace Incursions Tracker Update — Aug 21, 2026
summary: Germany opened a new national drone-security research centre in Cochstedt, Saxony-Anhalt on August 18 — two weeks after an explosive-laden drone was discovered beside a Ukrainian cargo plane at Leipzig/Halle Airport — while NATO conducted a high-end air-defence exercise of an estimated 25-50 aircraft over Poland and the Baltic near Kaliningrad the same day, featuring a U.S. EA-37B electronic-warfare aircraft and a NATO E-3A AWACS. No new airspace incursions, intercepts, or shootdowns were reported since the August 16 Spanish F/A-18 shootdown near Galați. KPIs, map points, assets, political figures, and claims updated to reflect the new counter-drone and air-defence deployments.
